Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the very first step by misidentifying the director of the film "Aurora" (2018). The WebSurfer's initial search results clearly showed that the 2018 film "Aurora" was a Filipino horror thriller directed by Yam Laranas. However, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the director was Miia Tervo, who directed a film titled "Aurora" released in **2019**. This fundamental error in disambiguation (confusing the 2018 film with the 2019 film) led to the entire subsequent investigation focusing on the wrong person and yielding an incorrect answer regarding the birthplace of the actual 2018 director.
